description: This file defines the ChangelogService class, responsible for managing changelog data, including downloading, version handling, and notifying listeners within a web or desktop environment for the application.

classes.name: ChangelogService
classes.description: Implements functionality for retrieving, caching, and managing changelog information, including version mapping for different environments and change notification mechanisms.

methods.name: addLastReadChangeListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for last read changelog version updates, returns a function to remove the listener.

methods.name: performDownloadChangelog
methods.description: Fetches changelog data from a remote URL and parses it.

methods.name: getChangelog
methods.description: Retrieves the changelog, either from cache or by downloading and processing, applying environment-specific modifications.

methods.name: markAsRead
methods.description: Marks the current changelog version as read, updates storage, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getLastReadVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the last read changelog version from storage.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of changelog versions.

methods.name: getLegacyMapping
methods.description: Provides version mappings depending on the environment (Desktop or Mobile).

methods.name: getDesktopDownloadsUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for downloading a specific desktop version.

methods.name: getDesktopVersionForWebVersion
methods.description: Maps a web version to its corresponding desktop version if available.
